office: the Ministry of Home Affairs, National Identity and Civil Registration

routes.label: at a National Identity and Civil Registration office

note: The National Identity Cards Act 2011: a citizen of Lesotho (or holder of an indefinite residence permit) of sixteen or over whose particulars are in the Register is eligible for an identity card, issued in the name of the King and valid ten years; replacements are at a prescribed fee. The fee for a first card or a renewal, and the time, weren't found (the Ministry's questions page gives passport fees only).

sources.title: Lesotho, National Identity Cards Act 2011 (Act 9 of 2011), WHO country planning cycle database copy
sources.said: Eligibility for identity card The following persons are eligible to be issued with identity cards provided that they have attained the age of sixteen and their particulars have been entered in the Register— ... An identity card shall be issued in the name of the King and shall be valid for a period of ten years.
